letter: You are offered a place at Nebula Hollow University.
Report tomorrow: Spiral Arm Campus, Orbit Road 20934.

meet.speaker: teacher
lines: Hello. I am Professor Lund.
Earthology Department.
You must be...

meet.speaker: player
lines: Yes! It's my first day of university.
I'm excited to start my Earthology major!

meet.speaker: teacher
lines: Excited. Good. Hold on to that.
We start today. Right now, in fact.

meet.speaker: teacher
lines: Get in.

arrival.speaker: player
lines: Where... where is this?

arrival.speaker: teacher
lines: This is Earth. Planet EaRtH20934.
We do not study from books here.
We study the real thing.

cabin.speaker: teacher
lines: I am staying too. Down here, I am your parent.
We moved to this town last week. That is the story.
This ship is our house. Submit your homework from it.
cabin.note: Cover story: parent and kid, just moved here. Submit from the ship.

cabin.speaker: teacher
lines: Nobody down here may learn what you are.
Put on a disguise before you step outside.
cabin.note: Nobody may learn what you are. Wear the disguise.

cabin.speaker: teacher
lines: Acceptable. You almost look like one of them.
Notebook is N. Map is M.
Go outside. Look at things. Make a friend.
cabin.note: Notebook N, map M. Go look at things. Make a friend.

a.label: The one with the beanie
a.describe: A beanie, a sweater, and a serious face.

b.label: The one with the headband
b.describe: Long hair, a knitted headband, a blue coat.

controls: Arrows or WASD: walk   E: look / talk   N: notebook   M: map
